comments.author: Brin

I installed this and three of the other mods he dropped with it, and I had the same issue as you.

After letting the game “load” for a few minutes, then opening the F12 menu ingame, hitting the “open log” button, and looking at the error, it looks like the problem is that the server is detecting non-compliance with MongoID enforcement.

I don’t know enough to try to fix that, but this mod seemed like the most likely culprit, and removing it “fixed” my install.
